query:
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO match_pins (
             library_id, kind, title, year, hint,
             pinned_tmdb_id, pinned_imdb_id, pinned_tvdb_id, pinned_at)
         SELECT library_id, kind, ?, ?, ?,
                pinned_tmdb_id, pinned_imdb_id, pinned_tvdb_id, pinned_at
         FROM match_pins
         WHERE library_id = ? AND kind = ? AND title = ? AND year IS ? AND hint IS ?
